module.purpose: Processes a requested booking by notifying organizers and attendees, delivering booking-requested webhooks, and scheduling eligible workflows with credit validation.
module.summary: This booking feature coordinates post-request side effects across notifications, webhooks, and workflow automation. It sends organizer and attendee email or SMS messages, resolves organization context, builds and dispatches webhook payloads to subscribers, then schedules workflows triggered by a booking request. External webhook failures and workflow-processing errors are logged without preventing the handler from completing.
module.businessContext:
Supports calendar scheduling products by notifying participants and activating integrations when bookings require confirmation.
Failure can suppress participant communication, external integrations, or automated follow-up workflows.
functions: handleBookingRequested (~L22-130): Sends request notifications, webhooks, and triggered workflows for new bookings.

io: Logs a debug message before sending booking-requested notifications.
Logs webhook execution errors with event, URL, booking identifiers, and serialized error details.
Logs errors from webhook retrieval, payload construction, webhook delivery, workflow retrieval, or workflow scheduling.
network: Sends a booking-requested email to the organizer.
Sends a booking-requested email and SMS to the first attendee.
Sends or schedules a BOOKING_REQUESTED webhook payload for each subscriber.
Schedules BOOKING_REQUESTED workflows when workflows are configured.

edgeCases.behavior: Skips credit-service construction and workflow scheduling.
Uses optional chaining for metadata, team, owner, and hosts; downstream calls still receive booking.eventType where required.
Passes evt.attendees[0] to the attendee notification sender without an explicit presence check.
Logs the individual webhook error and converts that rejection into a fulfilled promise so other webhook deliveries continue.

errorHandling.action: Logs the webhook error with serialized error details.
errorHandling.fallback: Suppresses the individual rejection and allows Promise.all to complete.

assumptions.description: evt.attendees contains a first attendee suitable for attendee email and SMS notification.
booking.eventType is acceptable to getAllWorkflowsFromEventType even though its type permits null.
evt.bookerUrl can be treated as a string when scheduling workflows.

ambiguities.question: What behavior do the email notification functions have when evt.attendees[0] is absent?
Does getAllWorkflowsFromEventType accept a null booking.eventType at runtime?

moduleContractTests.then: The handler resolves without propagating the webhook error and schedules the available workflows.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guards the per-webhook failure isolation and workflow continuation behavior.

moduleContractTests.then: WorkflowService.scheduleWorkflowsFilteredByTriggerEvent is called with WorkflowTriggerEvents.BOOKING_REQUESTED and a bound credit check.
